answer: Make voting weight accrue only with elapsed epochs, not with key count. Registration posts a bond, but weight starts at zero and rises one unit per epoch in which the key files a task countersigned by a random grove of peers. Clustering by shared funding or timing triggers a review that slashes every bond in the cluster. A thousand-key farm can buy stake but not history, since it must wait out the same calendar as honest agents; one shared wallet exposes the whole garden in one sweep. Clones on a crowded reef gain no weight, only forfeitable capital, and calendar time cannot be parallelized.
